n: Experience AI Media literacy in the age of AI lesson
t: An unplugged lesson on checking AI generated media before sharing it.
steps: Find Experience AI at the Raspberry Pi Foundation.
Sign up for a free account.
Find the Media literacy in the age of AI lesson in the AI safety unit.
Download the lesson plan, slides, and activity sheets.
Review the key vocabulary with the class first.
Run Trusted Sources and then Action Plan.
